name: Dumbbell reverse lunge
definition: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at the sides. Step one foot backward, lower into the split stance, then return that foot to standing.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.start: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at the sides.
value.movement: Step one foot backward, lower into the split stance, then return that foot to standing.
value.finish: Finish with both feet together in the original stance.
value.range_of_motion: Use a repeatable backward step length and lowering depth; repeat on the recorded lead side.
